name: s3-def
description: synthetic-customer S3 (FICTIONAL), DELIBERATELY DEFICIENT: a 56-person defence cable-harness and electronics manufacturer on GCC High G3 + E5 Security, cloud-only, whose tenant grew without management. 60 accounts (56 staff, 1 shared shop-floor login, 2 admin accounts of which one is a former technician's idle 140 days, 1 emergency account in no CA exclusion); 3 standing Global Administrators (one the owner's licensed account), no PIM; 4 enabled accounts idle beyond 90 days and 1 leaver still enabled; most staff without MFA registration; 2 report-only MFA CA policies and no legacy-authentication block; 34 Windows devices (6 non-compliant, 9 with an untracked critical CVE); an unassigned compliance policy; no DLP, no CUI label; the CUI site shared to anyone; training missing; 2 Defender alerts new for 20 days.
